name: at-file-ref-grammar
opens_with: typing '@' at a word boundary in the composer
notes: Plan 2026-10-24 M4: the @ popup shares the slash-command palette. The grammar shape (values are @file:/@folder: tokens) is pinned by unit tests in prompt_input/tests.rs (file_ref_value_grammar_shapes, accept_file_ref_appends_space_and_uses_grammar, accepted_file_ref_token_injects_via_context_references) — the async fuzzy tier is sim-deterministic-disabled (maybe_spawn_file_suggest gates on is_simulating), so the live popup contents depend on the working directory; the unit layer is the honest oracle for the grammar.
